character: Upmarket Trentino resort in the Brenta Dolomites, lift-linked with Pinzolo and Folgarida-Marilleva as Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta. It hosts the Canalone Miramonti night slalom on the World Cup circuit (reference).
